summary: Iteration 8 (Subjects Architecture Upgrade) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py (23 tests, 22 pass) covering subject catalog CRUD + lookup, single theory/practical offering marks derivation, duplicate/bad-class/missing-subject validation, POST /api/subject-offerings/bulk (create, dedupe 'Already offered', 'Class not found', payload validation, anon/teacher authz) and Class-Hub regression lists. Frontend: Playwright flows for /app/subjects catalog CRUD, Class Hub Subject Offerings tab (theory 100 + practical 70+30=100 rendering), class-chip scoping (Class field hidden, list scoped), the 3-step bulk-offer dialog (unit preselect 4/4 -> deselect -> subject+practical marks 60/40 -> review -> apply 3 created -> rerun shows 3 'Already offered' skips + 1 created), offering row delete, data persistence after reload, and Classes/Sections/Enrollments/Teacher-Assignments tabs. Auth playbook spot-checks done. All test/seed data cleaned up (Greenwood back to 1 class 'Grade 6', 1 subject 'Mathematics', 0 offerings).

minor.issue: normalize_offering_marks() is not re-run on update (enrich_institution_doc is only called for enrollments/teacher_assignments/classes at server.py:372). Editing an offering to has_practical=true with theory=60/practical=50 persists a stale max_marks=100 instead of 110, so derived total desynchronises from theory+practical. Reproduced by test_update_offering_to_practical_renormalizes. Also no duplicate check on update.
allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True; CORS_ORIGINS exists in backend/.env — prefer explicit origins only (playbook requirement).

ui_bugs.issue: Type column renders the raw stored slug. Subjects created from the UI store type='practical'/'core' (option values) so the list shows lowercase 'practical' instead of the label 'Practical / Lab' (API/label-created rows show 'Practical / Lab'), i.e. inconsistent display for the same concept. Add a value->label render mapping (and normalise legacy/empty values, seeded 'Mathematics' shows '—').

'Theory max (if practical)' and 'Practical max (if practical)' inputs are always visible even when 'Has practical / lab' = No, and 'Max marks' stays visible when it is Yes — misleading (the bulk dialog correctly toggles between them).
Trash icon deletes immediately with no confirmation dialog — destructive action without confirm.

issues: Marks fields do not prefill from the picked subject's catalog default_max_marks (default stays 100/70/30), so the new catalog field has no effect on the offering flow
Section is a free-text input here but a Select (lookup/sections) in the single-add form — inconsistent, and a typo creates an offering for a non-existent section

action_items: Re-run normalize_offering_marks() (and the duplicate check) on PUT /api/res/subject_offerings/{id} so edited offerings recompute max_marks
Render subject 'type' via a value->label map on /app/subjects (and decide on one canonical stored value: slug vs label)
Conditionally show Max marks vs Theory/Practical inputs in the Class Hub offerings add form based on 'Has practical'
Optional: prefill bulk-offer marks from subject.default_max_marks; make bulk 'Section' a Select; set explicit CORS_ORIGINS
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_resource(): resource whitelist for enrich (line 372) omits subject_offerings — any derived-field logic silently stops applying on edit; consider always calling enrich for institution-scoped resources.
POST /api/subject-offerings/bulk loops with per-class awaits (find_one + insert_one); fine at current scale but use one $in existence query + insert_many for large units.
Subject 'type' has two competing representations (slug in frontend config options, free string accepted by backend) — validate with a Pydantic enum.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created classes 'QA Grade 7/8/9', subject 'QA Chemistry' (+ QA Biology via UI) and several offerings — all deleted afterwards; Greenwood restored to 1 class 'Grade 6', 1 subject 'Mathematics', 0 offerings.

UI testids verified: hub-tab-offerings, inline-field-<name>, inline-has_practical-toggle, hub-offerings-add-btn, hub-offerings-delete, open-bulk-offer, bulk-offer-*; subject dialog uses field-<name> + form-submit-btn (NOT crud-form-submit).
rca_of_the_issue: Derived-marks desync on edit: create path goes through enrich_institution_doc -> normalize_offering_marks, but update_resource only calls enrich for enrollments/teacher_assignments/classes, so PUT persists the raw payload and leaves max_marks stale. Subject type display bug: frontend option values are slugs ('practical') while the table renders row.type verbatim, and rows created outside the form store the label, producing mixed casing/format in the Type column.
